Name: The Robin Romance Mod
Author: soapierbean
Description:
[center][size=6][b]The Robin Romance Mod[/b][/size][/center]
This mod makes Robin datable and able to be married. It does so through making her a Custom NPC. Robin is now divorced from Demetrius and living with Leah. Her sister Veronica will replace Robin at the carpentry shop. Courtesy of Shadowfire1223, Veronica now has nice sprite/portrait artwork.

If Veronica is a dealbreaker, disable her in the config menu (if you have Generic Mod Config Menu) or the config file: This will simply add Robin as above but without Veronica. This means the normal Robin will continue to appear in the game aside the new Robin with no mention of each other. The datable Robin's birthday will be shifted by 1 day (Fall 22).

Look under Docs, or head to the official [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/robin-romance.150781/#post-3320503]Stardew Valley Forums[/url], to find the Robin Romance Guide, detailing how to trigger heart events, gift preferences, etc. Be warned that it may contain spoilers for the mod!

[b][size=4]Mod Compatibility[/size][/b]

Generally compatible with almost any mod. If a mod affects Robin specifically (sprites & portraits usually), and is not made to support Robin Romance, you will need to edit the mod to prevent it from applying to Veronica (sometimes deleting the sprites/portraits is sufficient). All mods that don't support this mod and target "Robin" target Veronica in this mod, not Robin (the custom NPC that you can romance). This also means that dialogue that targets Robin will affect Veronica in theses situations and may break some lore/continuity within this mod.

Stardew Valley Expanded, Pregnancy Choice (coming soon), and Gender Neutrality mods fully supported. Also has support for Bachelor/Bachelorette gender swap mods (use the config options to set their names). The mod runs fine with Expanded, but as they update their mod, there may be new changes that aren't incorporated within this mod, especially in regards to Veronica.

If you have custom dialogue for various NPCs (Demetrius, Maru, etc.) and this mod seems to be interfering, try disabling the RRomanceAdditionalDialogue config option. Most of the other NPCs are being altered through the use of that part of the mod, though there are a few stray lines in the various content.json in the Robin Romance and Veronica files.

I was unable to obtain full permissions (I did receive it from some modders, but not others), so I have no ability to support seasonal outfits for this mod. Please don't ask.


[center][b][size=6]Credits[/size][/b][/center]

[size=5][b]Shadowfire1223[/b][/size] created the new Veronica portraits and sprites, as well as an alternate spritesheet for Robin complete with a unique wedding dress. Check out their profile [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/23394399]here[/url].

[b][size=5]Warhorse[/size][/b] for proofreading the mod and helping with not only testing events for me, but spelling, grammar, and wording errors.

[center][size=6][b]Before You Install[/b][/size][/center]

This mod requires Content Patcher & TMXL Map Toolkit (needed to add Robin's spouse room; as of 1.6, without this mod, you'll get Abigail's spouse room instead). It seems people have run into various issues installing through Vortex, so I've disabled the option. If you are having issues, make sure to delete any remnants of this mod in your mod folder, then download and install manually. I don't know why this mod has problems with Vortex, so I'm unable to correct it.

If updating from 1.3.1 or earlier, you need to also delete [CP] Ram w Veronica or [CP] Ram no Veronica from your mod folder.
If updating from 1.4.0, you need to delete [CP] Robin Romance from your mod folder.

Before You Install: Backup your save files! Save files with Custom NPCs (which this mod is) will not load without the Custom NPC. Note so long as you don't use this mod on your existing save files, those files should be safe, but once a save file has added this mod, it will require this mod in order to load. I believe you can use save edits to remove them, but I'm unsure of how and if this can be done. Please take caution and consider starting a new save file if you are concerned about this.

May or may not play nicely with Vortex. If you experience issues, delete [CP] Robin Romance from your mod folder, then install manually.

[size=6][b]Other Languages[/b][/size]

A [url=https://tieba.baidu.com/p/5902363876]Chinese Translation[/url] is available courtesy of erinyang.

A [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5701]Russian Translation[/url] is available courtesy of Ghost3lboom

There are no current plans to add more translations. If you want to translate the mod, go for it! If I have the time, I will make the mod more friendly for translations, as since I've stopped modding, it appears i18n has been introduced.
[b][size=5]

The 1.5.0 Update
[/size][/b][size=3]I'll update this page later. Mod should work on 1.6 now. I've added various new things from 1.6 as well, such as Robin's winter outfits. If events were broken before 1.6, they've been fixed now. Robin now appears at weddings if you marry another NPC. Changed my author name to "Soapierbean". Pregnancy role compatibility temporarily removed as the mod wasn't updated for 1.6 and won't work. Should still be compatible with Expanded aside from minor continuity errors. [b]Bugs[/b]: Some festival scenes are displaying Robin facing the wrong way or not in the right spot. Shouldn't cause any issues. Still testing for further bugs, but none so far aside from the spouse room's light coming in through the area.

Also, it appears this mod was tagged for sexualized content? That is not the case and I've removed the tag. There is nothing spicier than what is found in the base game itself.

Can't promise I'll get to it, but I see there's a more translation friendly option for mods now, so I'll try to get it updated to work with the i18n over the next few weeks.[/size][b][size=6]
[/size][/b]

[size=5][b]More Mod Info[/b][/size]

Hate Veronica's artwork? If you disable her Sprites/Portraits, then you can use your favorite Robin sprite/portrait mods instead for Veronica.

Robin's Portraits: If you target "Ram", how the game refers to Robin in this mod, it should be possible to use your favorite Robin portrait mods. However Robin does have 3 portraits that were added, so anytime those 3 portraits are called it will instead feature a Robin with no portrait. Note you can't change sprites, otherwise Robin won't do the right animations. Well you can, but it might not always line up with what she should be doing however.

Collaborations: I'm willing to work with other modders to make this mod better.

Use of this mod: Please make sure to give credit if you use this mod's content. Please also ask permission if you want to include this mod or a significant part of this mod in one of your mods, especially for anything to do with a Robin romance mod. For parts of this mod not made by me, you need to obtain permission from the appropriate modder.

Is this mod broken by a new version of Stardew Valley? Feel free to upload a fixed unofficial version if I don't seem to be around.

You can find this mod on the [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/robin-romance.150781/#post-3320503]Stardew Valley forums[/url] as well. Only download from the Official Stardew Valley forums or Nexusmods, no other site has my permission to distribute this mod.

[size=4][b]Archived Update Info[/b][/size]

[spoiler][b]1.4.0 Update Info[/b]

I've updated the mod to work with the newest Content Patcher standards. I was unaware of some of the changes, so the mod has likely not been  working as intended for a long while (dialogue should change when you're married to Robin, for instance).

Added a ridiculous amount of configuration options. Probably too many. This is now one mod, and Veronica can be turned off in the config options.

Stardew Valley Expanded, Gender Neutrality, Pregnancy Roles, misscoriel's Unique Courtship, and any bachelor to bachelorette or vice versa mods are now fully supported. Stardew Valley Expanded was previously supported, but now the lore should match up more with this mod's. Bachelor to bachelorette mods are any mods that swap the gender of the bachelors/bachelorettes in the game.

Robin now appears in the flower dance!

Movie info should be corrected and now working for Robin and Veronica.

14 Heart event hopefully no longer has a chance to crash (still not entirely sure I fixed it).

[spoiler]Ginger Island not properly supported, as of now you should see Robin and get her dialogue, but the NPC you're talking to is Veronica (or non-datable Robin). Not sure if the datable Robin might try to appear, in which case there could be errors or glitches (she doesn't have a swimsuit). Looking into making this fully work, but unsure if I can fix it.[/spoiler]

Without permissions for all sprites, I can't support the seasonal outfit mods, so please don't ask. If I get the permissions, I plan to attempt to support those mods (my spriting skills are lacking, but I basically need to just make a kissing sprite for each outfit, so it's not impossible).

[b]1.3 Update Info[/b]

After failing to update this mod for so long (sorry), it's finally here. Veronica now has custom dialogue and is no longer a slightly better than basic replacement for Robin. Other characters talk about Veronica. Other NPCs talk about Robin. Some NPCs may even change their dialogue depending on events with Robin. For the additional NPCs, these aren't huge additions, just a few lines, but Veronica now has far more dialogue.

But wait, that's not all! Veronica now has a 4 heart event. She also gets an 8 heart event if you're married to Robin.

Various fixes have been added to this version of the mod. Robin should no longer be referred to as your husband (why that's even happening I've got no clue; she is set to be female in the code). Her dialogue should hopefully be fixed for the completion of the community center. Issues with differing dialogue based off of the player's gender have now been fixed.

[b][size=4]The user Warhorse [/size][/b]went over virtually the entirety of the mod and helped to correct various spelling, grammar, and wording issues. Hopefully the dialogue looks cleaner and flows better. 

I've done some minor touchup to existing events. Music has now been added more aggressively. I'm not much of a music aficionado, but hopefully I picked some decent tracks for the mood of the events. I've cleaned up the flow of the dialogue (adding extra breaks, etc.). The 8 heart event no longer requires you to enter the area on a certain day and the 10 heart event no longer requires you to not be married to Robin (though it's highly suggested you do it before marrying Robin). The 10 heart event now has a glow affect around the campfire. It's not perfect, but hopefully it helps a bit.

Oh and Robin now has a 14 heart event. With tons of paths. Like, a lot. Probably not as much as some other mod out there, but it's a lot. You even have to loop through all of your possible options because, well, I couldn't find a way for the events to handle more than 2 branching choices at a time. Please be warned it has crashed on occasion while looping through those options. You should be safe on your first loop, but it does crash upon entering the third loop after the *hold hand* path. I will put how to trigger the event under Further Plans for those who are having a hard time (it's really simple, but just in case people don't want to be spoiled).[/spoiler]

[size=5][b]Further Plans[/b][/size]
These are things I plan, however they may or may not be finished. I don't have much time for modding at the moment.

Fix some of the remaining bugs, notably the issue with Robin facing the wrong way at some festivals.

Add i18n support for easier translations.

Add Ridgeview Support (mostly changing characters to refer to Veronica where appropriate).

Make the spouse room independent of TMX. I'm unsure if I'll have the time to get around to this.

I would love to create a spouse patio, but I have no ideas. Nor do I know how to actually make one that works in game. At this point, it probably won't happen.

[size=5][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]

Read "Before You Install" above. Make sure you have SMAPI, Content Patcher, & TMXL Map Toolkit (necessary only for the spouse room; will work without, but as of 1.6, you'll get Abigail's spouse room instead). Generic Mod Config Menu is recommended as well. Unzip this mod and put it in your mod folder.

[size=5][b]Closing[/b][/size]

Please let me know of any bugs or errors. Unfortunately, I'm not actively in the modding scene for Stardew Valley, so unless I check on Nexus, I may not see the bug reports. Sorry :/

This is my first Stardew Valley mod and I'm not particularly knowledgeable about modding, but I'll do my best to fix any issues. I'm pretty satisfied with it, and as I can't do much in regards to art, this is basically as good as it gets. I do intend to fix any game breaking bugs that pop up. Hope you enjoy it!

A very big thanks to all the modders on Discord, who are the entire reason this mod exists. It's due to them that I was able to put this together and actually make it work, as well as to those on the Stardew forums who helped me.

Another big thanks to Warhorse who took the time to help test my event fixes and proofread the vast majority of the mod for me.

TMXLoader's SpouseRoomTemplate was used to help design Robin's spouse room, thanks to the authors of those mods.
